title: Scanning Electron Microscopy Noise Classification Using Machine Learning
content: Noise is inherent to all measurements in experimental physics. In a scanning electron microscope (SEM), noise in the final image can be attributed to the electron source, beam-specimen interaction and the detectors [1]. For microscopists, the goal is to capture high-quality images and hence boosting the image signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is of prime importance. Many experimental and computational techniques have been developed over the years to tackle noise in SEM [2-4]. In this work, we show how we can use machine learning to classify noise in an SEM image.
